steps.title: Define Architecture and Data Schemas
steps.description: Establish localStorage data contracts for products, sales, expenses, customers, and business configuration.

steps.title: Build Master Layout and Responsive Sidebar
steps.description: Draft the responsive dashboard viewport with dual-theme classes, collapsible side navigation, and top header.

steps.title: Craft Custom Design System and Animations
steps.description: Implement theme variables, card elevation, print styles, and modal animations in CSS.

steps.title: Develop Interactive Executive Dashboard
steps.description: Create KPI cards (Revenue, Expenses, Net Profit, Orders), recent activity table, and pure CSS/SVG revenue trends.

steps.title: Implement Product & Inventory Management
steps.description: Build inventory view with live search, category filtering, stock status badges, and product creation/editing modal.

steps.title: Implement Sales Registry & POS Billing
steps.description: Develop multi-item order checkout, automatic tax and discount calculations, and instant stock deduction logic.

steps.title: Implement Printable Invoice Generator
steps.description: Generate dynamic printable modal invoices with line items, tax breakdowns, company headers, and print triggers.

steps.title: Build Expense Tracking Ledger
steps.description: Create expense entry form, categorized log with search/filter, and budget burn summary.

steps.title: Implement Customer Directory & Histories
steps.description: Construct customer profiles with contact records, purchase tallies, and lifetime spend tracking.

steps.title: Build Financial & Inventory Reports Engine
steps.description: Implement daily, weekly, and monthly summaries with breakdown charts and printable business summaries.

steps.title: Implement Business Settings & Theme Preference
steps.description: Add business name, currency symbol, tax percentage preferences, and persistent dark/light mode toggle.

steps.title: Implement CSV Export & JSON Backup System
steps.description: Enable full JSON data export, JSON restore validation, and CSV export for sales, expenses, and inventory.

steps.title: Integrate Demo Data & LocalStorage Seed Logic
steps.description: Provide a rich set of realistic sample products, sales transactions, and expense records with reset ability.

steps.title: Implement Feedback Dialogs & Toast Notifications
steps.description: Add non-blocking toast notifications and custom confirmation modals for safe record deletions.

steps.title: Building smartbusinessmanager
steps.description: Validate cross-device responsiveness, offline persistence, and verify all arithmetic calculations.
